payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit 3304ac8). Search subsystem ported: frick-store sqlite-fts5 adapter over the 0009 search_indexes+FTS5 tables (upsert/delete/query/rebuild; bm25 ranking; json_extract filters bound as params; empty-q short-circuit); the facade drives indexing in its write funnel via an installed SearchOp projector (failures swallowed, no store re-entrancy/deadlock). frick-server SearchRegistry (parallel to projections), POST /search route (limits + per-hit visibility post-filter + reserved __frickSource* strip), and GET /_frick/inspect/search report. 37 new tests. Adversarial review found + I fixed one real bug: the store rejected hyphenated filter keys the route accepted, silently dropping the clause (unfiltered results) — now aligned to [A-Za-z0-9_-] and fails loud. SQLite-first; PG tsvector arm is the documented FR-242 follow-up (fails closed on PG).
